subject: Bump fast-uri to 3.1.6 in reply-schema-linter to clear CVEs (#4571)
reason: The change only bumps the fast-uri npm dependency (3.1.0 to 3.1.6) in utils/reply-schema-linter/package-lock.json, a Node.js lint tool run in CI to validate command reply schemas. No Valkey server code, command behaviour, replication/persistence path, or shipped tool (valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark, valkey-check-rdb/aof) is touched, so no fuzzer scenario can reach the change and none is needed.
